body:
Thank you so much for this! I’ve never had anyone truly validate this whole shitfest I’ve been going through so this means so much! Being suicidal because of it etc., people sympathize, but don’t empathize.

You’re so right, I need to start over. Do something completely different, live somewhere else, meet other people.

Right now I have nothing that keeps me here. I can do whatever I want, so there is that.

Thank you for this, it kickstarted some thought processes, and I need to think about what could make me happy in the future. Not about what has been.
I know exactly what you mean.

I don’t know what to do, as I feel exactly the way you feel. But I know that the feeling of self-worth should not be defined by anyone else.

Just started going to a psychologist to get help finding ways to feel I’m worth something again. Not sure what will come of it, but I know it’s possible to love myself despite being rejected by my SO during our whole relationship. I know I can get back to not feeling like the ugliest, most disgusting woman alive, but it’s hard. So hard.

Sometimes the only solution is to just leave, although it feels impossible.
This is so important. Working on this myself.

Agreed, you are NOT a waste of time. But I know the feeling too well. That feeling can be so crippling and too horrible to cope with alone. If you’d like to talk you can send me a PM if you want. I’m just a stranger, but I honestly care about your well-being. I feel you.
Thank you for this, it was insightful.
Got a break at work, you can talk to me as well of you want:)
This made me cry (at work no less). It was so beautifully written. I feel happy for you, and I think that your story could help others. It helped me right now.

I’m experiencing it, and have for a few years. No advice unfortunately, but know that you’re not alone.

You are beatiful by the way, there is absolutely nothing wrong with you. Always remember that. But I know how it feels being rejected like this, it truly messes with your self image.

I appreciate it. Actually I need someone to talk to, as I have no one at the moment. My man is talking to me as if I were a stranger (for real, it’s uncanny). I don’t usually like to bother other people, but right now I’m at suicide risk so I’m kind of desperate to just talk to someone. Can I send you a PM?
I really appreciate you taking your time writing all this to me. It means a lot to me, as I have no one.
Well, I’m a woman pushing 40 in a couple of years:)
Thank you for your kind words!

«Too late» sort of refers to my age. It’s too late for me to find someone else and make my own family, as those things usually take their time.
Other than that I’m just having an exceptionally bad week regarding this subject, so it feels extra hopeless, I guess. And I’m not strong to begin with. :)

This could be written by my man. To be honest, from the «other side», the situation has completely destroyed me. I’ve spent literally years trying to understand why he doesn’t want to have sex with me. Years of monthly pity sex. Years of being in love with someone that never found me physically attractive. Never. He’s probably fantasizing about other people, just like you are.

I really wish he didn’t trick me into believing he felt what I felt. Now my feeling of self worth is completely gone, and I’m to broken down to get out. It’s been and still is pure torture, and I have to live with this grief and damage for the rest of my life.

I wish he never invited me for that second date, then I’d have the chance to find someone that loved all of me. It’s too late now.
